headline: Approved $100,000.00 for Bella Apartments redevelopment of Brightwood School, and an amended Youth Commission ordinance.
summary: Bokul Bhuiya, director of the Springfield Parking Authority, presented a strategy on grants, garage upgrades, and on-street parking. A motion to send that presentation to the Finance Committee was made and seconded. The honorary street for Cornel Forbes, three Eversource items, and easements at 82 and 74 Crystal Brook Drive also passed with no votes against.
decisions: Approved naming an honorary street for Cornel Forbes, 12 to 0.
Approved the Eversource item on Oakland Street, 12 to 0.
Approved the Eversource item on Plainfield Street, 12 to 0.
Approved the Eversource item on Dwight Street, 12 to 0.
Approved an order granting the city a permanent easement at 82 Crystal Brook Drive, 12 to 0.
Approved an order granting the city a permanent easement at 74 Crystal Brook Drive, 12 to 0.
Approved the amended ordinance on the Youth Commission, 12 to 0.
Approved $100,000.00 for Bella Apartments redevelopment of Brightwood School, 9 to 2 with 1 abstention.

TONIGHT, IT WAS VETTED BY THE CPA.  PRESIDENT WHITFIELD STEPPED DOWN

STATED THAT SHE WILL NOT BE IN FAVOR OF THIS ITEM.  STATED THAT THE 
CITY CLERKS DOES A GREAT JOB AND ENJOYS WORKING WITH HER.  SHE 
STATED THAT EVERYONE SHOULD GO THROUGH THE SAME PROCESS THAT SHE 
WENT THROUGH IN HER OWN ETHICS INVESTIGATION.  COUNSELOR FENTON 
ALSO WATCHED THE COMMITTEE MEETING.  HE ASKED IF THE ETHICS REPORT 
CAN BE SHARED WITH TH BODY.  COUNSELOR HURST STATED THAT HE CANNOT 
SHARE THE REPORT WITH THE BODY.  COUNSELOR WALSH ASKED HOW 
UNFINISHED BUSINESS APPEARS ON THE AGENDA.  PRESIDENT WHITFIELD 
STATED IT WAS BROUGHT BACK BECAUSE ITEMS WERE BEING LEFT OUT OR 
FORGOTTEN.

Order Granting Easement to City of Springfield at 82 Crystal Brook Drive 
 (Lot 10 of Street Expansion Plan for Crystal Brook Drive) 
 
WHEREAS, the City of Springfield  a municipal corporation with a principal place of business located at 
36 Court Street, Springfield, Hampden County, Commonwealth of Massachusetts, hereinafter referred 
to as the “Grantee” have requested Hirving Henriquez of 82 Crystal Brook Drive, (“Grantor”) to grant 
them a permanent easement over an 800 square foot portion of land at 82 Crystal Brook Drive (Parcel # 
035110042); and 
 
WHEREAS, the permanent easement is needed so that Grantee may service and maintain the retention 
pond and storm water maintenance area; and 
 
WHEREAS, said easement area is located on a portion of the Grantor’s land on Empress Court (Parcel 
#035110042) in the City of Springfield, County of Hampden, Commonwealth of Massachusetts, and 
more particularly shown on the plan entitled "Crystal Brook Drive Street Extension, Crystal Brook Drive, 
Springfield, MA, Scale 1" = 30' Date: February 28, 2022, prepared by Alfred Benesch & Company”, which 
plan is recorded with the Hampden County Registry of Deeds in Plan Book 396, Page 72. 
 
WHEREAS, the draft Easement (Exhibit #1) is attached hereto; and  
 
NOW THEREFORE, BE IT ORDERED, that the Mayor be and is hereby authorized in the name of and on 
behalf of the City of Springfield, to take all steps necessary to execute and record an instrument granting 
a permanent easement to the City of Springfield, for the purposes described in this Order, in 
substantially the same form as the draft Easement attached hereto as Exhibit #1, for consideration of 
One Dollar ($1.00).
